input.goal: Implement the approved A2 hero composition using semantic HTML and the existing client asset library. Write the regression test before changing site code.
acceptance: Match headline-left, conversion-block-left and vertical-rocket-right composition at 1440 by 900.
Keep the exact approved navigation, headline, supporting copy and CTA labels.
Do not overlay the rocket on any text or control.
Use #F8F8F6 as the page canvas, #0B0D11 as ink and #FFC552 as the sole accent.
At 375 by 812, stack content before the rocket with no horizontal overflow or clipped text.
Use transform and opacity only for motion, with reduced-motion fallback.

input.goal: Compare desktop and mobile screenshots to the approved golden and report only observable failures.
acceptance: Unified Quality Gate reports no runtime, network, overflow, clipping or broken-image failure.
Visual review confirms the rocket does not cover content and the hero CTA is visible in the first viewport.
